karty.priklad: mewn cyfarfod o'r gymdeithas Gymraeg leol
karty.priklad_cs: at a meeting of the local Welsh society (cymdeithas → [g]ymdeithas after the article 'r, feminine)
karty.mnemo: Members of the society COME DAY after day (cym-DEITH-as) to toast marshmallows round a roaring bonfire.

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn chwarae yn y nant.
karty.priklad_cs: The children are playing in the stream.
karty.mnemo: Your NAN Tiptoes (NANT) across the stream – the water has turned to bubbling red lava.

karty.priklad: trefnu parti pen-blwydd arbennig i berthynas neu ffrind
karty.priklad_cs: organise a special birthday party for a relative or friend (perthynas → [b]erthynas after i)
karty.mnemo: A relative from PERTH (PERTH-ynas) turns up at the family party on a red double-decker bus.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically feminine even for a male relative

karty.priklad: Daeth hi yma i Ward 5 ddoe.
karty.priklad_cs: She came here to Ward 5 yesterday.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: the ward sister hands out red-hot chilli soup to every bed.

karty.priklad: mewn agoriad neuadd
karty.priklad_cs: at the opening of a hall
karty.mnemo: agor = to open: at the grand opening, A GORilla (A-GOR-iad) cuts the ribbon wearing ice skates.

karty.priklad: Dyfan yw arweinydd côr y pentref.
karty.priklad_cs: Dyfan is the conductor of the village choir.
karty.mnemo: The conductor waves an icicle as his baton and hides his WINE (ar-WEIN-ydd) in a snowdrift.

extra.pozn: the ending -ydd = masculine noun, often a person (p. 5)

sever.priklad: Dyfan ydy arweinydd côr y pentref.
sever.priklad_cs: Dyfan is the conductor of the village choir.

karty.priklad: Bydd bwffe ar ôl y cyfarfod.
karty.priklad_cs: There'll be a buffet after the meeting.
karty.mnemo: Just 'buffet' spelt the Welsh way: everything at this buffet is frozen solid, even the sausage rolls.

karty.priklad: Daeth y meddyg i weld ei glaf e ar Ward 5.
karty.priklad_cs: The doctor came to see his patient on Ward 5 (claf → [g]laf after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: A penguin nurse puts a bag of frozen peas on the patient's broken CALF (CLAF).

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a female patient

sever.priklad: Daeth y meddyg i weld ei glaf o ar Ward 5.
sever.priklad_cs: The doctor came to see his patient on Ward 5 (claf → [g]laf after ei = his).

karty.priklad: Trefnu digwyddiad yn Nant Gwrtheyrn
karty.priklad_cs: organise an event at Nant Gwrtheyrn
karty.mnemo: At the event everyone has to DIG WITH (DIG-WYDD) teaspoons through a glacier.

karty.priklad: Roedd fy nhad-cu i'n gweithio fel glöwr.
karty.priklad_cs: My grandad worked as a miner.
karty.mnemo: glo = coal: the miner's lamp GLOWS (GLÖ-wr) blue in a tunnel full of icicles.

sever.priklad: Roedd fy nhaid i'n gweithio fel glöwr.
sever.priklad_cs: My grandad worked as a miner.

karty.priklad: Byddwch chi'n gweld gwahaniaeth yn y dysgu.
karty.priklad_cs: You'll see a difference in the learning.
karty.mnemo: 'Go, HANNAH!' (gwa-HAN-iaeth) – Hannah spots the difference between two snowmen.

karty.priklad: Beth yw eu hoedran nhw?
karty.priklad_cs: How old are they? (oedran → [h]oedran after eu = their)
karty.mnemo: 'OY! You DRANk that at your AGE?' (OED-ran) – Grandad downs a blue slush puppy and gets brain freeze.

sever.priklad_cs: How old are they? (oedran → [h]oedran after eu = their)
sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5)

karty.priklad: Gaf i eich sylw chi?
karty.priklad_cs: May I have your attention?
karty.mnemo: A polar bear climbs a SILO (SYL-w) in the middle of the hall – that gets everyone's attention.

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i gyflwyno Dafydd Roberts, eich tiwtor newydd chi.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to introduce Dafydd Roberts, your new tutor (cyflwyno → [g]yflwyno after hoffwn i).
karty.mnemo: 'May I introduce… the man with the WINE from the LOO? NO?' (cyf-LWY-no)

karty.priklad: Mae'r radio'n mynd i gyfweld â fy nhad-cu i.
karty.priklad_cs: The radio is going to interview my grandad (cyfweld → [g]yfweld after i).
karty.mnemo: cyf- (together) + gweld (to see): in an interview two people 'see each other' – just like inter-VIEW.

sever.priklad: Mae'r radio'n mynd i gyfweld â fy nhaid i.
sever.priklad_cs: The radio is going to interview my grandad (cyfweld → [g]yfweld after i).

karty.priklad: Mae hynny'n swnio'n dda!
karty.priklad_cs: That sounds good!
karty.mnemo: sŵn = a sound, said like SOON: 'Lunch SOON?' – 'That SOUNDS good!'

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi ymuno â'r gymdeithas Gymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She has joined the Welsh society.
karty.mnemo: un = one: to join is to become ONE with the group.

karty.priklad: siaradwr annibynnol
karty.priklad_cs: an independent speaker (B1 level)
karty.mnemo: an- (not) + dibynnol (dependent) = in-dependent, built exactly like the English.

karty.priklad: Rhywun rhy fusneslyd?
karty.priklad_cs: Someone too nosy? (busneslyd → [f]usneslyd after rhy)
karty.mnemo: busnes = business: a nosy person pokes into everyone else's BUSINESS.

karty.priklad: Dyw fy chwaer i ddim yn gweithio ar hyn o bryd.
karty.priklad_cs: My sister isn't working at the moment.
karty.mnemo: Literally 'at this (hyn) of time (pryd → bryd)'.

sever.priklad: Dydy fy chwaer i ddim yn gweithio ar hyn o bryd.
sever.priklad_cs: My sister isn't working at the moment.
sever.pozn: north: dydy instead of dyw (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dechreuon ni ddysgu ar-lein yn y cyfnod clo.
karty.priklad_cs: We started learning online during lockdown.
karty.mnemo: clo = lock (think CLOse): a period (cyfnod) under lock.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; masculine like cyfnod (L5); pl. cyfnodau clo (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Gyda llaw, ble mae Anti Mair?
karty.priklad_cs: By the way, where's Auntie Mair?
karty.mnemo: Literally 'with hand': by the way = an offhand wave of the hand.

karty.priklad: Mae Sam wrth ei fodd yn dysgu Cymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: Sam loves learning Welsh (bodd → [f]odd after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: bodd = delight: literally 'at my delight'.

extra.pozn: base form bodd; persons: wrth fy modd, wrth dy fodd, wrth ei fodd (he), wrth ei bodd (she), wrth ein bodd, wrth eich bodd, wrth eu bodd

karty.priklad: Dw i'n dda iawn, diolch i chi am ofyn.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm very well, thank you for asking (gofyn → ofyn: the g drops after am).

karty.priklad: Dw i'n gweithio yn swyddfa Llandudno dros dro.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm working in the Llandudno office temporarily.
karty.mnemo: tro = a turn: dros dro = 'for a turn', just for now.

karty.slovo: Diolch i chi am y cyfle.
karty.priklad: Diolch i chi am y cyfle i siarad heno.
karty.priklad_cs: Thank you for the opportunity to speak tonight.
